name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
description: Common Paper's mutual NDA standard terms, allowing two parties to disclose confidential information to each other while evaluating a potential business relationship.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
description: Fillable cover page that incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms and captures the deal-specific details (purpose, term, governing law) needed to execute the agreement.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering service access, support, payment, liability, and confidentiality terms.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard terms for giving a partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a product development program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard terms defining uptime and support response-time commitments and the service credits a customer can claim if those targets are missed, designed to be used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for engaging a services provider to perform work under one or more statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, IP assignment, payment, and liability.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard terms governing the processing of personal data between a controller and processor (or processor and subprocessor), including international transfer mechanisms (EEA SCCs, UK Addendum) and security incident response.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing on-premises or self-hosted software, covering license grants, restrictions, updates, warranties, and liability.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for a business partnership between two companies, including cooperation obligations, trademark licensing, payment, and confidentiality.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard HIPAA business associate agreement terms governing a service provider's use and protection of protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard terms for a short-term trial or evaluation period that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a longer-term commercial agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Standard terms supplementing a Common Paper agreement to govern the use of AI services, including input/output ownership, model training rights, and AI-specific disclaimers.
